notes: Keys MUST be addressable by Grudge ID (not raw puter_uuid) so that when a user claims a guest Puter account with an email, storage remains reachable.

sdks.purpose: Client-side Puter SDK (ai/kv/fs/auth). Loaded by all Grudge frontends that use AI, guest login, or cloud storage.

clientFlow: 1. Any auth path on any Grudge frontend.
2. If Puter SDK is available, call puter.auth.signIn() -> puter.auth.getUser() -> { uuid, username }.
3. POST { puterUuid, puterUsername } to /api/auth/puter (rewritten to id.g-s.com/auth/puter).
4. Backend upserts (puter_uuid <-> grudge_id). Auto-creates server-side Solana wallet + Puter cloud storage on first touch.
5. Returns { token, user } — token stored as localStorage 'grudge_auth_token'.

namingConvention.rule: Always reference the actual live slug. Some Grudge Puter slugs are hyphenated (grudge-crafting.puter.site, grudge-studio.puter.site) and others are not (grudgewarlords.puter.site, grudgestudio.puter.site).
